resources.string: Put maps, music and your ride data on your Zontes dash.\n\nThis guide takes about 3 minutes: a few permissions, Android Auto, then you scan the QR on the dash and you\'re connected. After that, one tap on CONNECT is all it takes.

• Camera: scan the QR on the dash
• Location: Android needs it to find and join the bike's Wi-Fi
• Nearby devices: talk to the dash over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
• Notifications: keep running while you ride

Nothing leaves your phone.

ZRide Screen sends Android Auto (Google Maps, Waze, Spotify…) to the dash, so it must be installed.

One-time switch, in Android Auto's settings:
1. Scroll down and tap "Version" 10 times (developer mode)
2. Tap ⋮ (top right) → "Start head unit server"

After a phone restart, only step 2 again.

1. Switch the ignition on.
2. On the dash, open the phone-connection screen (MotoPlay / EasyConnect) and leave it open.
3. A QR with the Wi-Fi name and password appears. That is the one to scan. Not the app-download or vehicle-info QR.

On the phone: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on, VPN off, and close the official bike app.

Tap the button and point the camera at the QR on the dash.

Android may ask to join the bike's Wi-Fi. Tap Connect. After a few seconds the picture appears on the dash.

The bike is saved: next time just tap CONNECT, no scan.
Not working? \"Invalid QR\" means the wrong QR (see step 4). Stuck on connecting: switch the ignition off and on, then Connect again. Still stuck: Help → Send log.
